about: One supported panel. Read by the firmware YAML (esphome/, !include), tokens/layout.json devices (tools/gen_layout.mjs), the docs site (install page, engine.ts), deploy.yml and the issue templates (boards/templates.mjs). status: target = a release firmware is built for it. memory: keep_pages = how many deck pages the panel keeps built (facet-243). The Guition's CONFIG_SPIRAM_MALLOC_ALWAYSINTERNAL stays in its board package (an sdkconfig string). performance: measured, accepted numbers (facet-245).
name: Guition ESP32-S3-4848S040

performance.about: Accepted for 1.0 (facet-245): tap to first frame with the deck's pages kept, measured 96-212 ms (Weather 96, Calendar 133-134, Home 137-145, Clock 205-212). Each full frame spends ~60 ms copying LVGL's internal-RAM strips into the PSRAM frame (460 KB at the PSRAM bandwidth the RGB panel's refresh leaves) and 25-140 ms drawing (Clock's large digits the most). No shadows or gradients in the Facet theme; PSRAM 80 MHz octal, 64 KB data cache. Turning the 90-degree mount in the driver instead of ESPHome saved ~3 ms (reverted).
